title: lobivia maximiliana var. quiabayensis
intro: Lobivia maximiliana var. quiabayensis, commonly known as Quiabaya cactus, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce pain, improve wound healing, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Quiabaya cactus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which may exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Quiabaya cactus for medicinal use.
